mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_discount(discount_id, discount_name, discount_desc, discount_type, market_plan, market_expr, status) values(#{discountId}, #{discountName}, #{discountDesc}, #{discountType}, #{marketPlan}, #{marketExpr}, #{status})
mapper.update: update group_buy_discount set discount_name = #{discountName}, discount_desc = #{discountDesc}, discount_type = #{discountType}, market_plan = #{marketPlan}, market_expr = #{marketExpr}, update_time = now() where discount_id = #{discountId}
